An '''arthropod''' found in the [[Desert/Legends|deserts]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] was a dangerous burrowing creature that had a long segmented body with [[Color/Legends|brown]] skin, with spikes on its head and red eyes. It would emerge above ground and attack its prey with pincers on the end of its four limbs.
